description:
[RSSAmp] How big the directory is, what it is made of, and whether the crawler is keeping up. `stale` is active feeds not read successfully in a day; `due` is a backlog that should drain within a tick or two. Answer this before concluding a feed is missing — it may simply not have been crawled yet.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).
name: rssamplifier_directory_stats
title: RSSAmp: Directory and crawler status
